+"""Deterministic lowering of actual AI-selected intent files; not AI decisions."""
+import sys
+from prepare import ROOT, OUT, read, write, ref, now, sha
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'experiments/value_added_r6_16'))
+from generate import generate
+
+
+def main():
+    for p, h in read(OUT / 'SOURCE-FREEZE.json')['files'].items():
+        assert sha(ROOT / p) == h, p
+    files = {}
+    for eid in ('S01', 'S02'):
+        folder = OUT / 'episodes' / eid
+        intent = read(folder / 'AI-INTENT.json')
+        start = now()
+        source, ir = generate(intent, 'C')
+        with (folder / 'APPLICATION.py').open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
+            f.write(source)
+        write(folder / 'SYMBOLIC-IR.json', ir)
+        write(folder / 'VALIDATION.json', {'status': 'VALID', 'utc': now(),
+            'intent': ref(folder / 'AI-INTENT.json'), 'symbolic': ref(folder / 'SYMBOLIC-IR.json'),
+            'application': ref(folder / 'APPLICATION.py'),
+            'validator': 'unchanged generate.check + lower + generate_mutable validators',
+            'corrections': 0, 'new_execution_semantics': False})
+        write(folder / 'SCRIPTED-LOWERING.json', {'kind': 'DETERMINISTIC_NOT_AI_TOOL_TRAJECTORY',
+            'started': start, 'finished': now(), 'function': 'R6.16 generate.generate',
+            'arguments': {'intent': intent, 'track': 'C'},
+            'response': {'source': ref(folder / 'APPLICATION.py'), 'ir': ref(folder / 'SYMBOLIC-IR.json')},
+            'ai_selected_input': 'actual current-session apply_patch; see AI-CONSTRUCTION transcript'})
+        for name in ('AI-INTENT.json', 'APPLICATION.py', 'SYMBOLIC-IR.json', 'VALIDATION.json', 'SCRIPTED-LOWERING.json'):
+            p = folder / name
+            files[p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()] = sha(p)
+    write(OUT / 'CANDIDATE-FREEZE.json', {'utc': now(), 'files': files,
+        'source_freeze_sha256': sha(OUT / 'SOURCE-FREEZE.json')})
+    print('Two AI-selected production-backed intents validated, lowered and frozen')
+
+

+"""AI-free, fresh-process state transitions, exact rejection bytes and restart."""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+from prepare import ROOT, OUT, read, write, canonical, sha, ref, now
+
+
+def invoke(app, request, directory):
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'experiments/value_added_r6_16/transport.py'),
+        str(app)], cwd=directory, input=json.dumps(request), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
+    return p, json.loads(p.stdout) if p.returncode == 0 else None
+
+
+def run(eid):
+    folder = OUT / 'episodes' / eid
+    observations = []
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='lykoi-r649-') as tmp:
+        store = Path(tmp) / 'records.json'
+        for index, case in enumerate(read(folder / 'ACCEPTANCE.json')['cases']):
+            before = store.read_bytes() if store.exists() else None
+            p, actual = invoke(folder / 'APPLICATION.py', {k: case[k] for k in ('op', 'args', 'providers')}, tmp)
+            after = store.read_bytes() if store.exists() else None
+            records = json.loads(after) if after is not None else []
+            expected = case['expected_records']
+            invariants = all(type(r['label']) is str and bool(r['label'].strip())
+                and r['phase'] in read(folder / 'FRC.json')['state_domains']['phase']
+                and r['seal'] in ('open', 'closed')
+                and (r['phase'] != 'released' or r['seal'] == 'closed') for r in records)
+            checks = {'process_success': p.returncode == 0, 'output_match': actual == case['expected'],
+                'state_match': records == expected, 'invariants_preserved': invariants,
+                'rejection_or_read_bytes_unchanged': not case['rejection_bytes_unchanged'] or before == after}
+            observations.append({'index': index, 'request': {k: case[k] for k in ('op', 'args', 'providers')},
+                'returncode': p.returncode, 'stdout': p.stdout, 'stderr': p.stderr, 'actual': actual,
+                'storage_before_hex': before.hex() if before is not None else None,
+                'storage_after_hex': after.hex() if after is not None else None,
+                'checks': checks, 'passed': all(checks.values())})
+        before = store.read_bytes()
+        p, result = invoke(folder / 'APPLICATION.py', {'op': 'list', 'args': {}, 'providers': {}}, tmp)
+        restart = {'returncode': p.returncode, 'stdout': p.stdout, 'stderr': p.stderr, 'actual': result,
+            'persisted_bytes_hex': before.hex(),
+            'passed': p.returncode == 0 and result == {'ok': expected} and store.read_bytes() == before}
+    return {'episode_id': eid, 'observations': observations, 'final_restart': restart,
+        'passed': all(o['passed'] for o in observations) and restart['passed']}
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--pass-id', choices=(1, 2), type=int, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    for seal in ('SOURCE-FREEZE.json', 'CANDIDATE-FREEZE.json'):
+        for p, h in read(OUT / seal)['files'].items():
+            assert sha(ROOT / p) == h, p
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    results = [run(e) for e in ('S01', 'S02')]
+    body = {'utc': now(), 'pass_id': args.pass_id, 'ai_calls': 0,
+        'execution_ms': round((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000),
+        'candidate_freeze': ref(OUT / 'CANDIDATE-FREEZE.json'), 'results': results,
+        'observations_sha256': hashlib.sha256(canonical(results)).hexdigest(),
+        'fresh_process_requests': sum(len(r['observations']) + 1 for r in results),
+        'passed': all(r['passed'] for r in results)}
+    write(OUT / ('REPLAY-%d.json' % args.pass_id), body)
+    print(json.dumps({'pass': args.pass_id, 'passed': body['passed'],
+        'fresh_process_requests': body['fresh_process_requests'],
+        'observations_sha256': body['observations_sha256'], 'execution_ms': body['execution_ms']}))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Read-only successor review: historical contracts, symbols and frozen suites."""

+import sys
+import time

+

+import composition as c
+
+

+    'E01': 'two byte sum; capacity120; reads before capacity before end',
+    'E02': '2*fragile+ordinary; ceiling600; reads before quote before end',
+    'E03': 'binary agreement; first flag validation precedes second read; returns a',
+    'E04': 'binary exactly-one; both reads precede flag validation; returns sum',
+    'E05': 'version7 before count read; count<=12; returns count',
+    'E06': 'three reads; low<=high then low<=reading then reading<=high',
+    'E07': 'nested pair-add tally of three bytes; ceiling300',
+    'E08': 'shared double/triple compositions; 2*a+3*b; ceiling1000',
+}
+
+
+def observations(eid):
+    folder = OLD / 'episodes' / eid

+        expected = copy.deepcopy(case['expected'])
+        if 'error' in expected:
+            role = expected['error'].pop('role')
+            expected['error']['node'] = root if role == 'program' else root + '/' + role
+        assert all(k in actual and type(actual[k]) is type(v) and actual[k] == v for k, v in expected.items())
+        rows.append(actual)

+

+        original = next(e for e in old_ledger['entries'] if e['episode_id'] == eid)
+        row = {'episode_id': eid, 'family_id': original['family_id'],
+            'historical_status': original['admission_status'], 'successor_tier_t': 'T_CANDIDATE_ADMITTED',
+            'tier_e': 'NOT_QUALIFIED', 'meaning_review': MEANINGS[eid],
+            'source_authority': 'preserved owner-authorized synthetic fixture source; not independent human approval',
+            'training_authorization': 'R6.49 explicit review as training candidates; research-preparation scope',
+            'third_party_requirement_material': False, 'same_coordinator': True,

+            'known_correctness_defects': [], 'known_evaluation_set_leakage': False,
